idea: The remainder when p(x) is divided by x−a is p(a). So x−a is a factor exactly when p(a)=0. Each known remainder or factor gives one equation for the unknown coefficients.
trap: Plugging in x=−a for the divisor x−a.
desmos: Desmos evaluates p(a) in a blink, but unknown coefficients still need equations from you.
